ExxonMobil's average quarterly total revenue for fiscal 2025 was about **$83.1 billion**. This is an estimate built from recalled quarterly figures, not checked against the filings. The fourth-quarter number in particular is uncertain.

The figures below use "total revenues and other income":

| Quarter | Total revenues and other income |
|---|---|
| Q1 2025 | ≈ $83.13B |
| Q2 2025 | ≈ $81.51B |
| Q3 2025 | ≈ $85.29B |
| Q4 2025 | ≈ $82.3B (approximate) |
| **Full year** | **≈ $332.2B** |

Average quarterly revenue = $332.2B ÷ 4 ≈ **$83.1 billion**.

If the narrower "sales and other operating revenue" line were used instead, the average would be roughly $2 billion lower.
